productArea.name: Promotions
productArea.scope: Search, filter, sort, create, and edit promotions, including list columns, draft and scheduled states, named rules, catalog and order conditions and ranges, and save or discard behavior. Vouchers and editing products selected by a rule are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Discounts then Promotions, and open a promotion to edit its rules and schedule.
Choose Create promotion from the list.
